name: JigsawStack · A ledger of every vendor incident.
alt: Animated infographic: JigsawStack, Massive and your code in a stack card. A vendor's status page, fetched via Massive, shows daily uptime bars for its API, dashboard and webhooks. The API's latest bar turns red and the page switches to Investigating; three prompts, title, date and status, fly down to your ledger, where the older incidents step down and the new one appears on top. The JigsawStack request with its byo_proxy setting sits below. Headline: A ledger of every vendor incident.
